Moving within Los Angeles doesn't have to be stressful. Whether you're relocating across the street, to a new neighborhood, or anywhere within LA County, Splendid Moving provides reliable, efficient local moving services. A local move is typically defined as any move within 50 miles—and we've mastered the art of navigating LA's unique challenges, from tight parking to high-rise buildings.

What's Included in Every Local Move

  • Professional Moving Crew: 2-4+ trained, uniformed movers
  • 26ft Moving Truck: Clean, well-maintained vehicles with lift gates / ramps

Local Moving FAQs

Common questions about local moves in Los Angeles

Local moving rates in Los Angeles typically range from $115-$180+ per hour depending on crew size. Our rates start at $115/hr for 2 movers + truck, with a 3-hour minimum. The total cost depends on how long your move takes, which is influenced by the volume of items, distance, stairs, and parking accessibility.

We recommend being present at the start and end of your move to do walkthroughs and direct the crew. However, if you can't be there, you can designate a trusted person to be on-site in your place. Just let us know in advance.

Many LA neighborhoods require parking permits for moving trucks. You'll need to obtain these from the city, typically 3-5 days in advance. If parking is difficult, we can safely load from a distance or make multiple trips if needed.

We recommend booking at least 1-2 weeks in advance, especially for weekend moves or end-of-month dates which are busiest. However, we do offer same-day moves when our schedule allows—call us to check availability.

For safety and legal reasons, we cannot transport hazardous materials (gasoline, propane, chemicals), perishable food, plants, live animals, or pool tables. We also recommend transporting important documents, jewelry, and irreplaceable items yourself.

Yes! We have experience moving pianos, safes, antiques, artwork, and other specialty items. Just let us know in advance so we can ensure the right equipment and crew size. Additional charges may apply for very heavy or delicate items.

Coast-to-coast relocations across the entire United States. Your belongings handled with the same care, no matter the distance.

4.9 ★★★★★ 497 Google reviews 4.9 ★★★★★ 409 Yelp reviews Read 906 customer reviews

Nationwide Long Distance Moving Services

Whether you're moving from Los Angeles to New York, Texas, Florida, or moving to Los Angeles from another state, we provide reliable long distance moving services. We specialize exclusively in moves originating from or destined for the Greater Los Angeles area.

A long distance move is typically any move over 200 miles—and we bring the same quality and care to cross-country moves that we're known for locally.

What's Included

  • In-Home or Virtual Estimate: Accurate quotes based on your actual inventory
  • Full-Service Packing: Professional packing of all items available
  • Dedicated Truck Available: Your belongings travel together, not mixed with others
  • Door-to-Door Service: From pickup to final placement at destination
  • Dedicated Move Coordinator: Single point of contact for questions
  • Storage Options: Short and long-term if you need flexibility

How Long Distance Moving Works

1
Free Detailed Estimate

We'll do an in-home or virtual walkthrough to inventory your items and provide an accurate quote.

2
Choose Your Moving Date

Pick a pickup date that works for your schedule. We'll confirm delivery window based on distance.

3
Packing Day (Optional)

If you've selected packing services, our crew arrives the day before to professionally pack everything.

4
Loading & Transit

We load your belongings carefully and begin your move to your new destination.

5
Delivery & Placement

We deliver to your new home, place furniture where you want it, and do a final walkthrough.

Understanding Long Distance Pricing

Long distance moves are priced differently than local moves. Here's what you need to know:

  • Volume-Based Pricing: Cost is based on the amount of space your items take in the truck
  • Distance Factor: Mileage between origin and destination
  • Binding vs. Non-Binding Estimates: We offer binding quotes so you know your exact cost upfront
  • Additional Services: Packing, storage, and special handling quoted separately

How Payment Works

After we provide your quote and you decide to book:

  • Deposit: A small deposit of $100-$200 secures your moving date
  • At Loading: Half of the remaining balance is collected when we load your items into the truck
  • At Delivery: The final half is collected when we finish unloading at your new home

No surprise charges. The binding quote we provide is the price you pay, regardless of any changes on moving day (unless you add items).

Popular Routes from Los Angeles

We regularly handle moves from LA to destinations across the country:

  • California: San Francisco, San Diego, Sacramento, San Jose
  • Southwest: Las Vegas, Phoenix, Denver, Tucson, Albuquerque
  • Pacific Northwest: Seattle, Portland, Boise
  • Texas: Dallas, Houston, Austin, San Antonio
  • East Coast: New York, Miami, Atlanta, Boston, Washington D.C.
  • Midwest: Chicago, Minneapolis, Detroit, St. Louis

Don't see your destination? We move to all 50 states—contact us for a quote!

Interstate Moving Regulations

Interstate moves are regulated by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Splendid Moving is fully licensed and compliant with all federal regulations. You'll receive a Bill of Lading (your contract) and information about your rights and responsibilities as a shipper.

  • Flexible payment options

🛡️
Fully Insured Cross-country protection

Long Distance FAQs

Common questions about interstate and cross-country moves

Delivery time depends on distance and how urgent your situation is. Nearby places (California, Nevada, Arizona) typically take 1-2 days. Midwest destinations take 3-4 days. East Coast destinations can take up to 5-6 days. We'll provide a delivery window when you book and keep you updated throughout transit.

We understand plans can change. If you need to adjust your delivery date, let us know as soon as possible. We offer storage options if there's a gap between when you leave your old home and when you can receive items at your new one.

Federal regulations prohibit moving hazardous materials (gasoline, propane, chemicals, ammunition), perishable food, and plants. Some states have restrictions on specific items. We also recommend keeping important documents, jewelry, medications, and irreplaceable items with you.

Yes, we offer both short-term and long-term storage options. This is helpful if your new home isn't ready yet or if you need time to find a place at your destination. Your items stay in our secure, climate-monitored facility until you're ready for delivery.

We'll send you a detailed preparation guide, but key tips include: declutter before you pack, keep essentials with you (medications, important docs, phone chargers), label boxes by room, take photos of electronics setups, and arrange for parking at both locations. If you've booked packing services, just make sure fragile and valuable items are identified.

Nationwide Long Distance Moving Services

Whether you're moving from Los Angeles to New York, Texas, Florida, or moving to Los Angeles from another state, we provide reliable long distance moving services. We specialize exclusively in moves originating from or destined for the Greater Los Angeles area.

A long distance move is typically any move over 200 miles—and we bring the same quality and care to cross-country moves that we're known for locally.

What's Included

  • In-Home or Virtual Estimate: Accurate quotes based on your actual inventory
  • Full-Service Packing: Professional packing of all items available
  • Dedicated Truck Available: Your belongings travel together, not mixed with others
  • Door-to-Door Service: From pickup to final placement at destination
  • Dedicated Move Coordinator: Single point of contact for questions
  • Storage Options: Short and long-term if you need flexibility

How Long Distance Moving Works

1
Free Detailed Estimate

We'll do an in-home or virtual walkthrough to inventory your items and provide an accurate quote.

2
Choose Your Moving Date

Pick a pickup date that works for your schedule. We'll confirm delivery window based on distance.

3
Packing Day (Optional)

If you've selected packing services, our crew arrives the day before to professionally pack everything.

4
Loading & Transit

We load your belongings carefully and begin your move to your new destination.

5
Delivery & Placement

We deliver to your new home, place furniture where you want it, and do a final walkthrough.

Understanding Long Distance Pricing

Long distance moves are priced differently than local moves. Here's what you need to know:

  • Volume-Based Pricing: Cost is based on the amount of space your items take in the truck
  • Distance Factor: Mileage between origin and destination
  • Binding vs. Non-Binding Estimates: We offer binding quotes so you know your exact cost upfront
  • Additional Services: Packing, storage, and special handling quoted separately

How Payment Works

After we provide your quote and you decide to book:

  • Deposit: A small deposit of $100-$200 secures your moving date
  • At Loading: Half of the remaining balance is collected when we load your items into the truck
  • At Delivery: The final half is collected when we finish unloading at your new home

No surprise charges. The binding quote we provide is the price you pay, regardless of any changes on moving day (unless you add items).

Popular Routes from Los Angeles

We regularly handle moves from LA to destinations across the country:

  • California: San Francisco, San Diego, Sacramento, San Jose
  • Southwest: Las Vegas, Phoenix, Denver, Tucson, Albuquerque
  • Pacific Northwest: Seattle, Portland, Boise
  • Texas: Dallas, Houston, Austin, San Antonio
  • East Coast: New York, Miami, Atlanta, Boston, Washington D.C.
  • Midwest: Chicago, Minneapolis, Detroit, St. Louis

Don't see your destination? We move to all 50 states—contact us for a quote!

Interstate Moving Regulations

Interstate moves are regulated by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Splendid Moving is fully licensed and compliant with all federal regulations. You'll receive a Bill of Lading (your contract) and information about your rights and responsibilities as a shipper.

Long Distance FAQs

Common questions about interstate and cross-country moves

Delivery time depends on distance and how urgent your situation is. Nearby places (California, Nevada, Arizona) typically take 1-2 days. Midwest destinations take 3-4 days. East Coast destinations can take up to 5-6 days. We'll provide a delivery window when you book and keep you updated throughout transit.

We understand plans can change. If you need to adjust your delivery date, let us know as soon as possible. We offer storage options if there's a gap between when you leave your old home and when you can receive items at your new one.

Federal regulations prohibit moving hazardous materials (gasoline, propane, chemicals, ammunition), perishable food, and plants. Some states have restrictions on specific items. We also recommend keeping important documents, jewelry, medications, and irreplaceable items with you.

Yes, we offer both short-term and long-term storage options. This is helpful if your new home isn't ready yet or if you need time to find a place at your destination. Your items stay in our secure, climate-monitored facility until you're ready for delivery.

We'll send you a detailed preparation guide, but key tips include: declutter before you pack, keep essentials with you (medications, important docs, phone chargers), label boxes by room, take photos of electronics setups, and arrange for parking at both locations. If you've booked packing services, just make sure fragile and valuable items are identified.
